items.item_text: Board certified or board eligible in Diagnostic Radiology.
Active or eligible California medical license.
Fellowship training in Pediatric Radiology or substantial clinical experience interpreting pediatric imaging studies.

At UCLA Health, your expertise can make a meaningful difference in the lives of our youngest patients. Join one of the nation's leading health systems and bring your passion for pediatric imaging to a collaborative environment dedicated to delivering exceptional patient care.

UCLA Health is seeking a board-certified/board-eligible Radiologist with expertise in Pediatric Radiology to join our growing team in a fully remote Staff Physician position. This opportunity offers the ability to provide specialized diagnostic imaging services for pediatric patients while collaborating with clinical teams across UCLA Health.

This position is primarily focused on pediatric imaging, with flexibility to incorporate general diagnostic radiology responsibilities based on physician interest. Full-time and part-time opportunities are available, offering physicians the ability to focus on clinical practice without required teaching or research responsibilities.
Provide diagnostic imaging interpretation for pediatric patients across a variety of modalities, including CT, MRI, ultrasound, and X-ray.
Interpret pediatric imaging studies to support accurate and timely diagnosis and patient care.
Collaborate with referring providers and multidisciplinary clinical teams to deliver high-quality imaging services.
Contribute to quality improvement and patient safety initiatives.
Practice fully remotely while supporting pediatric patient care across UCLA Health.
Focus on pediatric imaging with the flexibility to incorporate general diagnostic radiology based on individual interests.
Enjoy flexible full-time and part-time opportunities.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical teams across one of the nation's leading academic health systems.
Work with advanced imaging technologies and an integrated Epic environment.
Part-time compensation will be determined based on appointment percentage and applicable compensation arrangements.
Demonstrated expertise in pediatric diagnostic imaging.
Interest in working within a collaborative, multidisciplinary care environment.
